notes.title: Xenoscape Online Alpha Test
notes.content:
[h1][b]Welcome to Xenoscape Online!
[/b][/h1]
Embark on an epic gaming adventure with our live test of an exhilarating crossover between Pokemon and Realm of the Mad God in this one-of-a-kind MMO experience! Join forces with friends as you explore the vast and dynamic virtual world teeming with challenges and excitement.

[h2]Dungeons![/h2]
[b]Test your mettle in two distinct dungeons:[/b] Sunny Island and Polar Planes. 

[h3]Sunny Island[/h3]
[previewyoutube=vPaO7pcwZQo;full][/previewyoutube]
Sunny Island offers a tropical paradise filled with Pokemon-inspired creatures and challenges, a great place to start leveling. Battle low level enemies on the beach or take on some more challenging enemies in the water and grass.

[h3]Polar Planes[/h3]
[previewyoutube=p1Kt0cXiQ2g;full][/previewyoutube]

The Polar Planes presents a frigid landscape with unique and formidable enemies to conquer. Each dungeon promises a different set of thrills and rewards, encouraging players to strategize and adapt their gameplay.

[h2]Tons of characters![/h2]

[b]Choose from a diverse cast of elemental characters[/b], each with their own unique abilities and powers. Unleash the strength of fire, water, earth, and more as you navigate through this captivating realm. Whether you prefer the scorching flames of a fire-based character or the cool precision of a water-based hero, there's a playstyle to suit every gamer's preference.

[h2]Massive Multiplayer Online[/h2]

[b]This MMO is designed for collaborative play[/b], encouraging you to team up with friends to tackle challenges, defeat powerful bosses, and explore hidden secrets within the game world. Communicate, strategize, and forge alliances as you embark on an unforgettable journey together.

Immerse yourself in the fusion of Pokemon and Realm of the Mad God elements, combining the beloved creatures from the Pokemon universe with the fast-paced, bullet-hell gameplay of Realm of the Mad God. Prepare for an adrenaline-pumping experience that seamlessly blends two iconic gaming worlds.

Don't miss the chance to be part of this live test, where you can be among the first to explore and shape the future of this groundbreaking MMO. Gather your friends, choose your elemental character, and dive into a gaming experience like no other!
